title: olearia gunniana var. angustifolia
intro: Olearia gunniana var. angustifolia, commonly known as Gunn's daisy or narrow-leaved tree daisy, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in Australian folk medicine, offering various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Olearia gunniana var. angustifolia are attributed to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal effects include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic value.
